mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname, u.avatar as userAvatar, u.ex1 as userLevel, g.name as gameName, g.icon as gameIcon FROM t_post p LEFT JOIN t_user_info u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN t_game g ON p.game_id = g.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND (p.audit_status = 'approved' OR p.audit_status IS NULL OR p.audit_status = '') AND FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, p.favorites_user) ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
